nodes.name: OPNsense: Get Interfaces
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Create an HTTP Basic Auth credential named 'OPNsense API' with your OPNsense API key and secret.

nodes.name: OPNsense: Get DHCP Leases
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Endpoint is for OPNsense 26.1+ (Dnsmasq). For older ISC-DHCP installs use: /api/dhcpv4/leases/searchLease

nodes.name: Read Previous State
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Update /path/to/vault to the vault path on the SSH host (not the n8n container). NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs must be set in n8n's environment.

nodes.name: SSH: Write to tmp file
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: (1) Create an SSH Private Key credential. (2) Replace /path/to/claude with the full path to your claude binary — find it with: which claude

nodes.name: Write to Vault
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Update /path/to/vault/devices to the full path of your Obsidian vault devices directory on the SSH host.

nodes.name: Save Current State
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Update /path/to/vault to the vault root path on the SSH host.

nodes.name: Append Changelog
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Update /path/to/vault/changelog.md to the full path of your changelog file on the SSH host.
